title: Align with test-skills, proof-skills, housekeeping-skills, Quest and lore
description: Map perf rigor onto R1-R5, require pinned behaviour (coverage, ideally a kill matrix) before an optimisation, define proof-skills hand-off criteria, a home and cleanup rule for profiler artefacts, and Quest/lore recording of findings, baselines and rejected optimisations.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each skill names its hand-offs to test-skills, proof-skills and housekeeping-skills
Profiler artefacts have a documented home and cleanup rule
Quest and lore integration is demonstrated on a real example

finalSummary:
ADR-0007; each skill names hand-offs to test-, proof- and housekeeping-skills; .perf/ home + [junk] cleanup rule; Quest+lore integration demonstrated on PSKI-15 (lore report linked). Delivered in feat/PSKI-14-release-v0.1.0.

Landed via opum-ai/profile-skills PR #1 (squash 6147a89; validated commit 387f82f, no checks configured) and promoted to main by fast-forward (PR #2).
